name: spike-handoff
description: Spike: safe-boundary handoff (bundle written at turn.complete from the runtime bus) and $.turn.abort semantics

abortAfterCalls.title: Abort after N tool calls
abortAfterCalls.description: 0 = never; N = call $.turn.abort after the Nth tool call of a turn (spike only)

handoffAtPercent.title: Handoff at five-hour %
handoffAtPercent.description: Write a handoff bundle at turn.complete when five_hour percentUsed >= this
